title: Design System: GHM System public pages

accent.note: Placeholder until the client gives its company colour at kick-off; any replacement keeps at least 7:1 on white and all of these roles.

headline.purpose: The page h1, one per page; 30 px at 360 px, 36 px on desktop. Weight is the browser default for h1.

title.purpose: Section h2 headings. Weight is the browser default for h2.

body.purpose: Running text and input text; paragraphs capped at 65ch.

label.purpose: Labels, legends, choice cards, buttons, the site name.

hint.purpose: Hints, definition terms, message meta, in Soft Ink.

code-display.purpose: Reference number and PIN on the keep-these card, for copying exactly.

code-inline.purpose: Reference number in the status facts.

breakpoints.name: measure
breakpoints.purpose: Below: primary button full width (max-width). At and above: status facts in one row (min-width).

focusRing.purpose: Global :focus-visible outline on every focusable element.

borders.name: divider
borders.purpose: Between sections, under the header, contact group and team message frames.

borders.name: control
borders.purpose: Inputs (ink-soft), choice cards (line, accent when chosen), buttons and the notice line (accent).

borders.name: emphasis
borders.purpose: The keep-these card (accent) and the error summary (error).

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one main action of a form (Send, Check). Full width below 40rem.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border: 2px solid var(--accent, #0a5c70); border-radius: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Nirmala UI", "Kohinoor Devanagari", sans-serif); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; background: var(--accent, #0a5c70); color: var(--paper, #ffffff); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { border-color: var(--accent-strong, #07465a); background: var(--accent-strong, #07465a); color: var(--paper, #ffffff); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #0a5c70); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-btn-primary[aria-disabled="true"] { cursor: progress; } @media (max-width: 40rem) { .ds-btn-primary { width: 100%; } }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Ending actions (Done, Close), under a hint that says what they do.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-height: 3rem; padding: 0.75rem 1.5rem; border: 2px solid var(--accent, #0a5c70); border-radius: 0.5rem; font-family: var(--font, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Nirmala UI", "Kohinoor Devanagari", sans-serif); font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; background: var(--paper, #ffffff); color: var(--accent, #0a5c70); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { border-color: var(--accent-strong, #07465a); background: var(--accent-wash, #e3eef1); color: var(--accent-strong, #07465a); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #0a5c70); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Text Field
components.description: Label, hint, optional error line and a sturdy 2 px bordered input.
components.html:
Only the grievance team sees it.

Enter the reference number.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; margin-bottom: 1.5rem; font-family: var(--font, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Nirmala UI", "Kohinoor Devanagari", sans-serif); font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--ink, #1b2428); } .ds-field label { font-weight: 600; } .ds-hint { margin: 0; color: var(--ink-soft, #4b575d); font-size: 1rem; } .ds-error { margin: 0; color: var(--error, #b42318); font-weight: 600; } .ds-field input { width: 100%; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; border: 2px solid var(--ink-soft, #4b575d); border-radius: 0.375rem; background: var(--paper, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #1b2428); font: inherit; } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #0a5c70); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-field-error input { border-color: var(--error, #b42318); }

components.name: Choice Card
components.description: A radio option as a whole-row card; the chosen one has a teal border, a wash and the checked radio.
components.html: Your name?
components.css: .ds-choices { display: grid; gap: 0.5rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 0; font-family: var(--font, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Nirmala UI", "Kohinoor Devanagari", sans-serif); font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--ink, #1b2428); accent-color: var(--accent, #0a5c70); } .ds-choices legend { padding: 0; font-weight: 600; } .ds-choice { display: flex; gap: 0.75rem; align-items: flex-start; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.625rem 0.875rem; border: 2px solid var(--line, #c9d3d7); border-radius: 0.5rem; font-weight: 600; cursor: pointer; } .ds-choice input { flex: none; width: 1.375rem; height: 1.375rem; margin: 0.2rem 0 0; } .ds-choice input:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #0a5c70); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-choice-hint { display: block; margin-top: 0.25rem; color: var(--ink-soft, #4b575d); font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 400; } .ds-choice:has(input:checked) { border-color: var(--accent, #0a5c70); background: var(--accent-wash, #e3eef1); }

components.name: Site Header and Language Switch

components.css: .ds-header { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.5rem 1rem; padding: 0.5rem clamp(1rem, 4vw, 2rem); background: var(--band, #f2f6f7); border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #c9d3d7); font-family: var(--font, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Nirmala UI", "Kohinoor Devanagari", sans-serif); font-size: 1.125rem; } .ds-site-name { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; min-height: 2.75rem; color: var(--ink, #1b2428); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-site-name:hover { text-decoration: underline; } .ds-site-name:focus-visible, .ds-lang a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #0a5c70); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-lang ul { display: flex; margin: 0; padding: 0.125rem; list-style: none; border: 1px solid var(--accent, #0a5c70); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--paper, #ffffff); } .ds-lang a, .ds-lang [aria-current] { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; min-width: 2.75rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0.25rem 0.875rem; border-radius: 0.375rem; font-size: 1rem; font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-lang a { color: var(--accent, #0a5c70); } .ds-lang a:hover { background: var(--accent-wash, #e3eef1); } .ds-lang [aria-current] { background: var(--accent, #0a5c70); color: var(--paper, #ffffff); }

components.css: .ds-error-summary { padding: 1.25rem; border: 3px solid var(--error, #b42318); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--paper, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #1b2428); font-family: var(--font, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Nirmala UI", "Kohinoor Devanagari", sans-serif); font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.65; } .ds-error-summary:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #0a5c70); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-error-summary h2 { margin: 0 0 0.75rem; color: var(--error, #b42318); font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.35; } .ds-error-summary ul { margin: 0; padding-left: 1.25rem; } .ds-error-summary li + li { margin-top: 0.375rem; } .ds-error-summary a { color: var(--error, #b42318); font-weight: 600; text-underline-offset: 0.2em; } .ds-error-summary a:focus-visible { outline: 3px solid var(--accent, #0a5c70); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.css: .ds-thread { display: grid; gap: 1rem; margin: 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; font-family: var(--font, system-ui, -apple-system, "Segoe UI", Roboto, "Noto Sans", "Noto Sans Devanagari", "Nirmala UI", "Kohinoor Devanagari", sans-serif); font-size: 1.125rem; line-height: 1.65; color: var(--ink, #1b2428); } .ds-message { max-width: 90%; padding: 0.875rem 1rem; border: 1px solid var(--line, #c9d3d7); border-radius: 0.5rem; background: var(--band, #f2f6f7); } .ds-message-mine { justify-self: end; background: var(--accent-wash, #e3eef1); border-color: var(--accent, #0a5c70); } .ds-message-meta { display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.25rem 0.75rem; margin: 0 0 0.375rem; color: var(--ink-soft, #4b575d); font-size: 1rem; } .ds-message-meta strong { color: var(--ink, #1b2428); } .ds-message-body { margin: 0; overflow-wrap: anywhere; }

narrative.overview:
The public pages behave like a calm service counter: plain, private, and with nothing on it that distracts from the person in front of it. The visitor's own words come first. Everything else (the notice, the questions, the reference number and PIN, the replies) is laid out in one column of white paper with a pale band behind the header and the notice, one deep teal for anything that can be acted on, and the device's own system font in Nepali or English.

Density is low on purpose. Body text is 18 px, every target is at least 44 px, sections stand apart by 2.5rem and a hairline rule, and there is no decoration: no shadows, no motion, no icons, no illustration. The page is light only. The few moments that carry weight (the "keep these" card, the error summary, the message thread) are marked by heavier borders and a tinted wash, never by ornament.

The system is bound by durable product constraints, not by taste alone: no web fonts, no build step, no third-party requests, every form works with JavaScript off, every layout holds at 360 px in both scripts, WCAG 2.2 AA, and a self-only CSP that keeps every style in the one stylesheet. The accent is a placeholder until the client's company colour arrives at kick-off; its roles are fixed, its hue is not.
keyCharacteristics: One column, 40rem measure, white paper, a pale cool band for quiet grouping.
One accent, Placeholder Deep Teal, for every actionable or chosen thing and nothing else.
System font stack with Devanagari fallbacks; monospace only for the reference number and PIN.
Sturdy and obvious controls: 44 px and up, 2 px borders, whole-row choice cards.
Flat and still: no box-shadows, no transitions, no animations.
Meaning is never carried by colour alone: words, borders, position and the native control repeat it.

rules.name: The One Accent Rule
rules.body: There is one accent and it means "you can act on this" or "this is the one you chose". Pressed Deep Teal and Teal Wash are its states, not new colours. Nothing decorative is ever teal.

rules.name: The Seven to One Rule
rules.body: Placeholder Deep Teal stands in until the client's company colour arrives at kick-off. Any colour that replaces it must keep at least 7:1 against white (the placeholder is 7.56:1) and take over every one of its roles: links, primary buttons, the selected choice card, focus rings, the language switch, and the "keep these" card border. Pressed Deep Teal and Teal Wash are replaced with it, as its darker step and its pale wash.

rules.name: The More Than Colour Rule
rules.body: A state is never told by colour alone. A chosen card has a teal border, a wash and the checked native radio; an error has words, a red border and a summary that links to the field; "You" and "Grievance team" are written on each message, and position only repeats it.

rules.name: The No Web Fonts Rule
rules.body: The system stack is a product constraint, not a placeholder: no font is ever downloaded, so Devanagari renders in the device's own font.

rules.name: The Data Not Costume Rule
rules.body: Monospace is for the reference number and PIN, characters a person must copy exactly. It is never used for headings, labels or flavour.

rules.name: The Quarter Step Rule
rules.body: Each step from body to h2 to h1 is at least 1.25 times the one below, at phone width too.

rules.name: The Flat Counter Rule
rules.body: Nothing floats. A surface is set apart by the band, a rule or a heavier border, never by a shadow.

rules.name: The Still Page Rule
rules.body: No transitions, no animations. A state change is immediate.

rules.name: The Light Only Rule
rules.body: The pages declare `color-scheme: light` and have no dark theme. This is the current deliberate state, not a promise that one will never be added; a dark theme would need its own contrast pass against the Seven to One Rule.

dos: Do take every colour from the stylesheet's variables, so the company colour can replace the accent in one place.
Do keep any replacement accent at 7:1 or more against white and give it all of the accent's roles, with its darker step and its wash replaced alongside it.
Do make every target at least 44 px (2.75rem) in both directions, and make a radio option the whole row.
Do mark a chosen or wrong state with words or a border as well as colour.
Do use the 3 px teal outline with a 2 px offset for keyboard focus on everything that can take it.
Do separate form sections with 2.5rem, a 1 px Quiet Line rule and 2rem of top padding, with 1.5rem between questions inside them.
Do keep every public style in the one stylesheet; the self-only CSP forbids inline styles and scripts.
Do check every layout at 360 px and 320 px in Nepali and English, with JavaScript off as well as on.
Do keep print views and emails in the same plain voice: the system font, bilingual text, monospace only for an address or code someone must copy, and nothing loaded from another site.
donts: Don't add web fonts, icon fonts, glyph icons or illustrations.
Don't add box-shadows, transitions or animations.
Don't use the accent for decoration, or introduce a second accent hue.
Don't use monospace for anything except a reference number, PIN or address meant to be copied.
Don't let the 1 px Quiet Line be the only thing that shows where a control is; it is 1.52:1 and decorative.
Don't set the company's notice apart with a coloured edge; it sits on the band.
Don't add a dark theme without its own contrast pass.
Don't apply this system to the Filament admin panel; it keeps Filament's own UI.
